visualCharacteristics.summary: 2-up slider of text review cards (quote mark, rating, name, date, review) with dots and arrows
visualCharacteristics.layout: Text review cards, 1 per view on mobile and 2 on desktop; quote mark and rating at the top, reviewer name and date, then the review text; dots and arrows

contentPattern.structure: one row per review; lines may be in any cells/order and are recognised by content: rating ("4.5", "4.5/5" or stars), date (e.g. "20 Nov, 2025"), reviewer name (bold or heading line, or a short first line), optional avatar image, and the review text
contentPattern.source: 6 review cards: rating, reviewer name, date, quotation text

usage: Testimonials sections. Put the reviewer name in bold so it is never mistaken for review text.
reuseGuidance: Use for several short text reviews. A single pull quote is default content (blockquote).
implementationNotes: Shares the carousel engine in /scripts/carousel.js (prev/next, indicators, keyboard arrows, ARIA, autoplay with pause control) and helpers in /scripts/block-utils.js.
